title: docs(skills): name audit-compliance and access-policy-console among the cloud-only capability tokens
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x11xkYtNxy2NzQN7wCDayPc)_

Fixes #32041

## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 本 PR 为 **Tier H**(`skills/**`,`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 实测),当前 head 还欠契约审查(contract review),之后需一位授权审批人 Approve,再由 skills 席位落地。
改了什么:`objectstack-platform` 技能 `requires:` 一节的 **Enterprise / cloud** 条目补上 `audit-compliance` 与 `access-policy-console`,与 `main` 上 `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` 的四个仅云端令牌对齐。
为何:#32039 已把这两个令牌加入词表,技能原句只列 `ai-seat`、`governance`,AI 作者会漏声明或当成拼写错误。
付账:该文件 token 棘轮余量为 0;新增 45 字节由删除同节两处复述导语的从句(共 58 字节)付清,天花板不动(6011 → 实测 6009)。
扫描:技能内无其他列举仅云端令牌的句子,evals 无列举该集合的用例,不新增用例。

## Taught claims and their source on `main` (`e1146e806`)

| Claim in the skill | Source |
|:--|:--|
| `audit-compliance` and `access-policy-console` are platform capability tokens | `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` L85–L86 |
| Like `ai-seat` / `governance`, they are resolved only by cloud's objectos-runtime loader; this repository installs nothing for them | same file L77–L81 (the list comment) |
| They have no installable package: `package: null`, `edition: 'cloud'` | same file L238–L239 (provider rows); L143–L146 (the `package` doc names all four packageless tiers) |
| None of them, and no tier-gated token, is in the CLI's `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` map (the section's lead-in "not in that map") | `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts`: no entry for `ai`, `ai-studio`, `i18n`, `ui`, `auth`, `hierarchy-security`, `ai-seat`, `governance`, `audit-compliance`, `access-policy-console` |

Nothing on `main` contradicts the card: `git grep "'audit-compliance'"` / `"'access-policy-console'"` over `packages/` hits only `platform-capabilities.ts`, so neither token is resolved outside cloud.

## Changed lines (`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, § `requires:`)

```diff
-- **Tier-gated** — `ai`, `ai-studio`, `i18n`, `ui`, `auth` have no provider
-  entry; dedicated blocks in `serve.ts` `run()` open their tier instead
+- **Tier-gated** — `ai`, `ai-studio`, `i18n`, `ui`, `auth`: dedicated blocks
+  in `serve.ts` `run()` open their tier instead
   (`ai`/`ai-studio` through the intent-driven AI block).
-- **Enterprise / cloud** — `hierarchy-security` has no open-edition provider and
-  ships in `@objectstack/security-enterprise`, loaded through `plugins[]`;
-  `ai-seat` and `governance` are resolved only by cloud's objectos-runtime.
+- **Enterprise / cloud** — `hierarchy-security` ships in
+  `@objectstack/security-enterprise`, loaded through `plugins[]`; `ai-seat`,
+  `governance`, `audit-compliance` and `access-policy-console` are resolved
+  only by cloud's objectos-runtime.
```

The line breaks inside the two bullets moved; that is byte-neutral (a newline for a space) and pays nothing.

## The cuts and their surviving homes

The file had 0 tokens of headroom, so the +45-byte addition is paid by deleting two clauses that restate the section's own lead-in, "The tokens in `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` not in that map do not resolve through it" (L312–L313, unchanged), which both bullets hang from:

1. Tier-gated bullet: " have no provider entry;" (replaced by ":", −25 bytes). Surviving home: the lead-in "not in that map"; the bullet's own "dedicated blocks … open their tier instead" still says how they resolve.
2. Enterprise bullet: "has no open-edition provider and " (−33 bytes). Surviving home: the same lead-in, the bullet label **Enterprise / cloud**, and "ships in `@objectstack/security-enterprise`" in the same sentence. The fact also lives in `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` L421 ("paid `@objectstack/security-enterprise` plugin").

Both cuts are outside the four-token sentence but inside the same section, under the order's ratchet step 1 ("first cut true restatements in the same file"). The L99–L115 region that PR #32191 edits is untouched. Pins checked: no `packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts`, `scripts/**` or `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/*.json` text quotes either clause (`git grep "have no provider\|no open-edition provider"` hits only CLI runtime messages and their test, not skill text). `check-skill-identifier-liveness`'s `requires-capability-tokens` binding intersects `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS`, which names none of these tokens, and stays green.

## Ratchet reading

`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`:

| | Priced bytes | Tokens | Ceiling | Headroom |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `origin/main` `e1146e806` | 24044 | 6011 | 6011 | 0 |
| this PR | 24031 (+45 −58) | 6009 | 6011 | 2 |

No ceiling moves; `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not edited.

## Sweep

- `git grep -n -e ai-seat -e audit-compliance -e access-policy-console -e objectos-runtime -- skills content/docs ':!content/docs/releases'`: one hit, the edited line. The card's census holds.
- `governance` in `skills/objectstack-platform/**`: the same line only.
- `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` in `skills/objectstack-platform/**`: L312 and L322, which name the list without counting or enumerating it. Nothing else counts the tokens.
- Wider: `hierarchy-security` / `security-enterprise` in `skills/` and `content/docs/` (objectstack-data SKILL.md and its eval, `permissions/capabilities.mdx`, `permissions/sharing-rules.mdx`) are about the enterprise token alone and list no cloud token. No change.

**Evals:** `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` is the skill's only eval file. Its `requires` cases (`automation`/`triggers`, `push`, `mailbox`, the always-on `storage`/`settings`) name single tokens; none enumerates the cloud-only set. None fits, so no case is extended and none is added.

## Gates

On head `f9e455af`. Each command and its exit code is in `/mnt/project-files/card-32041/gates-f9e455af.txt` (project file).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` lists 47 commands for these two paths; all 47 exit 0, none NOT MEASURED.
- Run after `git fetch --deepen=300 origin main`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and a full `pnpm build`, under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test <both paths>` exits 3, its GOVERNED verdict code, not a failure.

Tier: **Tier H** (`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`: `skills/**`, the published skills catalog). The PR stays draft until it holds an authorized human approval; the skills seat requests it.

Contract-review tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` for `skills/**` (clause ①). Per the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-03, card threads do not run at that tier; the skills seat runs the contract review of record at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

Changeset: `.changeset/skills-platform-cloud-only-capability-tokens.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.
